rules.one_x_two_pair: Choose the two distinct fixtures with maximum product of 1X2 Top1 probabilities.
rules.handicap_pair: Choose the two distinct eligible fixtures with maximum product of handicap Top1 probabilities.
rules.total_goals_duplex: Choose the fixture with maximum sum of the two recorded total-goal Top2 probabilities.
rules.score_pair_duplex: Choose the two distinct fixtures with maximum product of their recorded score Top2 coverage; enumerate all four score combinations with probability products.
rules.joint_probability: Product of probabilities from distinct fixtures; theoretical independence assumption, not calibrated joint model.
rules.ties: Ascending fixture_id; for 100 plan ascending fixture_id tuple in category order.
rules.standard_400: For AVAILABLE 1X2 pair, handicap pair, total-goals duplex and score-pair duplex, distribute 200 two-yuan units proportional to their theoretical success probabilities, using largest remainders and lexicographic component tie-breaks. Excluded HTFT share is redistributed by renormalizing across available components. Split total and score component stakes among tickets proportional to their recorded outcome probabilities with the same two-yuan rule.
rules.free_100: Choose one 1X2 Top1, one handicap Top1 and one total-goals Top2 duplex on three distinct fixtures maximizing the sum of success probabilities; rank by probability, then fixture_id and category. Allocate 50, 30 and 20 yuan respectively. Split total-goals stake across its two outcomes proportional to outcome probabilities in two-yuan units.
rules.stability_and_consistency: No repeated frozen predictions or second national model are available. Temporal stability and cross-model consistency are UNAVAILABLE and are not invented or scored. Three distinct fixtures and categories provide deterministic diversification.
rules.half_full_time: UNAVAILABLE until a frozen HTFT model produces probabilities.
rules.high_odds_20: UNAVAILABLE while MARKET_VERIFIED is FALSE. No screenshot odds are used for EV or ROI.
